findings.description: The KMS key used for the audit trail bucket does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so the key material is never automatically rotated. Long-lived key material increases the impact window if the key is ever compromised and weakens cryptographic hygiene for audit log data.

No explicit policy attribute is defined for the KMS key, so AWS applies the default key policy that delegates full key access to the account root (and therefore to any IAM principal in the account with kms permissions). For a key protecting audit trail data this fails least privilege and lets broad account principals decrypt or disable the key.
